---
description: Run the anti-AI-slop writing check on a draft
argument-hint: path to the draft file
---

Read disciplines/10-writing-voice.md and apply it to the given draft:

1. Run the discipline's tier-1 grep against the draft file; rewrite every hit or justify it in one sentence.
2. Manually scan for the tier-2 context-dependent words listed in the discipline.
3. Scan for three consecutive same-shape sentences and for any paragraph restating a previous one.
4. Zero em dashes; no hype, self-praise, or unmeasured superlatives.
5. Cut 10 to 20 percent.
6. If the draft contains factual claims, run checklists/fact-check.md on it: every claim sourced, flagged, or deleted.

Report what was found and what changed.
